title: OpenAI's New AI Trained Its Own Successor With No Humans
description:
AI is now training AI, and OpenAI just crossed the line they said woud take years.

For the first time they took humans fully out of the loop. A model called GPT-5.6 Sol trained OpenAI's next model Luna basically on its own, they gave it a short prompt and it handled the config, the servers, the launch. 🔥

What used to take two senior researchers two full weeks is now one person, and compute for coding jumped like a hundredfold. On the RSI benchmark that measure how well a model improve itself, Sol beat the last generation by 16 points 😅

The gap between AI tool and AI developer is closing way faster then even OpenAI expected ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
